method: plumb_line (independent implementation 40_lines_indep; distortion from the straightness of verified straight edges)
model: k1,k2 radial (pixel units: k1/f^2, k2/f^4), distortion centre FREE (= principal point in the OpenCV form); f taken from the vanishing-point result (S1, pp = this centre) because straightness alone determines only k_i/f^(2i)

uncertainty.how: cluster bootstrap over physical edge members (resampled with replacement, 300 replicates, distortion re-fitted); k1,k2 with the f samples of the vanishing-point bootstrap (same replicates re-estimate plumb + VPs); f is NOT from straightness; HEADLINE 1-sigma = statistical (+) systematic in quadrature (review): systematic = half-range of the central values over the credible variants (radial model k1k2 / k1k2k3 / division-2; the two visible pieces of the blue floor line treated separately or as one straight line; straightness weighting), see details.review; *_stat / *_sys kept

data_used: 58 verified straight_3d edges (mean of the 7 jitter-corrected stills; files edges_cart310/cart80/scene.json, reviewed=True); duplicates removed; rejected as curved: cart80_x_A_front_in, cart80_x_E_front, cart80_x_E_front_in
geometry_assumptions: no dimensions and no sticker positions used; only: traced edges are straight 3D lines

details.rms_meaning: rms of the distances of edge points to their own best line, measured in the distorted image (px)
details.mapping_uncertainty_meaning: main value: distortion-only (f fixed at the VP value); 'mapping_uncertainty_with_f' includes the f uncertainty of the VP method
details.model_selection: leave-one-cluster-out CV of the straightness rms (px): k1 0.5133, k1k2 0.2532, k1k2k3 0.2573, k1_c 0.4778, k1k2_c 0.2057, k1k2k3_c 0.2136, k1k2_t 0.3111, k1k2_c_t 0.3014, div1 0.2265, div2 0.2077, div1_c 0.2386, div2_c 0.2161

summary: numbers reproduced; no code bug that changes the results

principal point / distortion-centre height is NOT determined to the bootstrap sd: it moves with the radial model and with the floor-line assumption (range of the credible variants: y = 426..512); x is determined to ~+-10 px

blue floor line (one painted line visible left of cart 310 and between the carts): with the main lens the piece between the carts lies +10.1 px off the straight line through the left piece and is rotated by 1.12 deg; with the pieces merged into one straight edge the free distortion centre moves to y ~510 without cost for the other edges (k1k2k3)
focal length is robust to these variants (half-range 8.6 px for this method)

stratified leave-one-VP-member-out jackknife (joint): sd f/cx/cy = [30.9, 3.4, 13.0] (bootstrap [20.6, 4.5, 22.0]); jackknife calibrated on synthetic data is ~unbiased but very noisy (8..37 px for a true 21.6 px)
cart split (joint, common vertical): cart-310 X only f = 1440, cart-80 X only f = 1489

budget.rule: systematic 1-sigma = half-range of the central values over the credible variants (main included); mapping: half of the largest median rotation-compensated displacement vs the main in the region

alternative_floorline_merged.model: ALTERNATIVE (review): as the main model, but the two visible pieces of the blue floor line (left of cart 310 / between the carts) are one straight 3D line (assumption: one straight painted line under cart 310)

uncertainty.how: no separate bootstrap; see the main entry
